title: Smoother with Vulkan
text: The game now draws through Vulkan (DXVK) on every graphics card that supports it, and laptops always use their dedicated card. The frame rate holds steady: no more sudden stalls in the middle of a fight. Vertical sync is turned off once, because it held slower PCs to 30 or 20 fps; you can turn it back on in Settings > Display. Older cards stay on DirectX 9 by themselves, and Settings > Display > Renderer switches between the two. Needs launcher 3.0.0-beta.12.

title: No more gun on the wall
text: With temporal anti-aliasing on, reloading while standing still could leave a faint copy of your gun on the wall in front of you until you moved. Fixed.

title: No more crashes on WWL
text: Joining the WWL server could crash the game, at random moments and in random places. The game kept too little room for what a busy server like WWL sends, and the overflow broke other parts of the game. That room is now big enough, so WWL plays like any other server. It comes with the next update, nothing to set up.

title: Steadier, sharper anti-aliasing
text: Temporal anti-aliasing now holds the picture still at every resolution: no more shaking in the distance and no more flickering edges on roofs and rocks at lower resolutions. Moving around also looks sharper, especially below 1080p - 900p now looks close to 1080p. Turn it on in Settings > Graphics > Remastered > Temporal anti-aliasing.

title: Smooth spawns, visible protection
text: No more stutter when players spawn - not even when Hardin, Silas or Billy the Kid join the fight. And every character now glows while they are protected after spawning, so you can see at a glance who can't be hurt yet. Many characters from the skin pack never glowed before. Update the Edition and enjoy a smoother game.

title: Every skin, smooth and protected
text: Whatever skins you pick for your classes - IranCoJ, Vanilla or your own mix - they now spawn without stutter and glow while protected, in every mode. Try a new look for your favourite class.

title: No more respawn freezes
text: The game froze for about a quarter of a second whenever anyone spawned: the spawn-protection glow of every character was built from scratch each time. The glow is now built once, while the map loads, so spawns are smooth again with every skin. New Classes 2.0.9 also keeps its shader cache when you change graphics settings, instead of starting over each time.

title: One badge per team
text: The team score at the top of the screen in Posse and Manhunt now shows each team's own badge at its end of the bar: the Lawmen's blue sheriff's star and the Outlaws' skull under a hat, the same ones as on the scoreboard. Launcher 3.0.0-beta.8: custom skins show in team modes too, Rancher and Redneck hide their picture with a custom skin, and characters without a voice of their own also get the game's third multiplayer voice.

title: Rain maps fixed
text: Rain maps such as Utah looked smeared and grey with Remastered graphics: the rain's depth effect could not be built while No DOF & Motion Blur is installed, and the game drew a placeholder over the whole screen. Fixed - rain looks as it should again.

title: Temporal AA, fixed
text: Temporal anti-aliasing now does what it should: smooth, steady edges, wires and foliage, with no shaking when you stand still and no trails when you move. Rivers and shores on Tombstone, Civil, Frisco, Fort Stanton and other maps no longer glow yellow in Remastered, and long bullet traces draw properly again. Turn it on in Settings > Graphics > Remastered > Temporal anti-aliasing.

title: Fixes: joining, map names
text: On most PCs the map name on the loading screen showed as a red box, or too big for its place: the sharp title font it uses was missing. The Edition now brings it along. With Remastered graphics on, joining a server could fail with a wrong map CRC: IranCoJ Graphics 1.1.1 fixes that. Launcher 3.0.0-beta.3: the Edition shortcut while the launcher is open plays from the open launcher instead of starting a second one, and Vanilla graphics give the game its own anti-aliasing back.

title: Your Edition stands on its own
text: The original game is only needed to create the Edition: after that the Edition updates from its own files, so you may uninstall the original if you want the space. New Editions can bring your profiles over from the game, and Settings > IranCoJ Edition has a button that copies any you don't have yet. Remastered graphics remember your choice while HD Textures isn't installed and turn on by themselves once it is, and uninstalling HD Textures gives New Classes its own characters back.

title:
The launcher
is in beta
text: Everything IranCoJ Launcher 3 is meant to do is here: the Edition, maps, mods, servers, the leaderboard and remastered graphics. From now on it is fixes and polish. The Edition shortcut on your desktop now opens the launcher, which updates itself, the Edition, maps and mods before the game starts. Found a bug? Let us know.

title:
Bound in Blood
Multiplayer
text: A separate multiplayer copy of your game with every IranCoJ map and mod. Your original game stays untouched.

title: Remastered graphics
text: Bound in Blood, remastered: physically based sun highlights and metal, ground-truth ambient occlusion, soft shadows on a 4096 map, temporal anti-aliasing, filmic colour, buildings, trees and props at full detail to the horizon, and three times the vegetation distance. Turn each part on or off in Settings > Graphics > Remastered, or go back to Vanilla. Remastered comes with IranCoJ HD Textures (install it in Mods): every texture at twice its resolution, your weapons and hands at four times, and the New Classes characters at full size. Needs launcher 3.0.0-beta.1.

title:
The leaderboard,
right here
text: The community leaderboard is now in the launcher: all time, this month or this week, with or without bot matches. Search any outlaw and open their full record.

title: Chat fixes
text: IranCoJ HUD 1.0.1: a wider chat that shows whole messages, names in team colours (orange without a team), green team chat and red server messages, shades that fit the kill feed and chat, the chat on the scoreboard from the moment you join, and no chat or kill feed over the class screen.

title: A new HUD
text: The whole in-game HUD is redrawn: sharper icons, a team score bar with the Lawmen star and the Outlaws skull, a cleaner kill feed with streak cards, a chat that colours names and tags and keeps five lines, your weapon's name when you switch, and a new Shootout and Wanted standing. Menus and loading screens got tidier too.

title: Third Person 1.0.5
text: Press F5 for an over-the-shoulder view. Your character now moves naturally on screen, the camera glides between first and third person, and the middle mouse button swaps shoulders. Skirmish and Manhunt stay first person.

title: Spectate Mod 1.1.1
text: Switching between first and third person glides like the Third-Person Camera, and the face hides at the same moment it does there. First-person spectating keeps the dot crosshair.

title: New Classes 2.0.6
text: Silas Greaves, John Wesley Hardin and Billy the Kid as the Rancher, Duelist and Rifleman. 2.0.6 brings the remastered tomahawk icon, no hands in the sniper scope and the crosshair styles.

title: Lincoln Town
text: The biggest map in the pack so far. It downloads with your next map update.

title: Showdown on IranCoJ
text: Join the IranCoJ server straight from the launcher, no menus needed.
